notes: Adds a Reviews > Moderation page: a fast triage queue for reviews submitted through the public API, newest first, with one-click Approve/Reject per row - the moment you act on one it drops off the list and the next pending review takes its place, no page reload needed. Rejected reviews stay rejected permanently and never resurface (previously there was no way to tell 'never looked at yet' apart from 'looked at and turned down' - both just read as not-approved). The main Reviews list is unaffected and still works exactly as before; it now also shows each review's status (pending/approved/rejected) as an optional column. Requires 'Update database' (adds a status column to reviews, backfilled automatically from existing approval state).
